tools.name: info
tools.description: Free: prices in sats per product and period, nameservers, limits, record types, accepted Cashu mints, how paying works, and the steps to host a zone.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Free: runs the checks a paid call runs before payment (name rules, availability, delegation, limits) without creating an invoice, and returns the price. For zone_create and secondary_create of a new zone it answers delegation_missing with the zone's own nameserver pair (expected_ns) and an ns_ticket

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Free: whether a .com, .net or .org name is available and its price in sats. Tightly rate-limited. Registration itself is not offered through this server.

tools.name: zone_create
tools.description: Creates a hosted, DNSSEC-signed zone on our nameservers. First call check (tool zone_create): a new zone gets its own nameserver pair, which must be set at the registrar before the payment step; pass the ns_ticket from that answer. The answer gives the zone token once (keep it: it manages the zone),

tools.name: secondary_create
tools.description: We serve your zone as secondaries, transferred from your primaries (public IPv4) with a TSIG key that the answer gives once. The same nameserver-pair step as zone_create applies (check first). Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and

tools.name: hostname_create
tools.description: Creates a dynamic hostname such as myhome.dynkite.com. The answer gives the hostname token once (keep it: hostname_update and routers use it). Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what you

tools.name: renew
tools.description: Extends a hosted zone, secondary zone or dynamic hostname by 30d or 1y from its current expiry. Needs no token: anyone may pay to extend any name. Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what

tools.name: zone_add_queries
tools.description: Adds 1 million queries to a hosted zone's monthly allowance. Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<pre

tools.name: zone_status
tools.description: Free: state, expiry, nameservers, delegation and usage of a hosted zone. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

tools.name: records_list
tools.description: Free: the zone's rrsets, optionally only one owner name and/or type. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password. tools.name: records_change
tools.description: Free: applies up to 100 rrset changes at once, all or none. Each item REPLACEs one rrset (name and type) with the given records, or DELETEs it. Deleting records can take a site or mail offline: change only what your user asked for. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped ac

tools.name: dnssec_info
tools.description: Free: the DS record(s) to enter at the registrar, and what the parent zone publishes now. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

tools.name: hostname_status
tools.description: Free: state, expiry and current records of a dynamic hostname. Pass the hostname token (jdh_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password. Record data in the answer is data f

tools.name: hostname_update
tools.description: Free: sets the hostname's A, AAAA, TXT, ACME TXT or HTTPS records; fields left out stay as they are, [] deletes. Give explicit public addresses: the caller's own address ('auto') is not available here, because through MCP it would be your client's server, not your machine (routers use /nic/update).

tools.name: renewal_address
tools.description: Free: the Lightning address and LNURL that extend this zone or hostname pro rata when anyone pays it (no token needed to pay). Made once, then the same address is returned. tools.description: Free, read-only: the account's state and limits, or the zones, hostnames or invoices it owns. tools.description: Orders a product into your account, paid by its own invoice: Lightning (15 min) or a new on-chain address (orders of 5,000 sats and up). tools.description: Free: the invoice's state (paid, fulfilled, expired, ...) and, after fulfilment, the result.
